title: Dark Dissension
caption: Dark Dissension (V)
game_text:
USED: ▲ Demotion. OR For remainder of turn, cancel the game text of an Imperial (except a Dark Jedi) present with another Imperial.
LOST: Cancel Imperial Command (unless limiting your battle destiny draws).
lore: The huge Imperial officers corps, with its high rate of turnover, is rife with competitiveness and ambition. Advancement comes at the expense of another’s career.
